svg.title: Wanderlog — Agent Loop Logic Flow
svg.text: api/agent.ts validates and prefetches, api/_lib/loop.ts runs the tool-use loop. Every step below happens inside one Vercel function invocation, as the signed-in caller.
2 · Context prefetch — under the caller's RLS
emit error · "Stopped after 16 steps without finishing."
Supabase client bound to the caller's JWT
— every later query runs under their RLS
whole trip tree in one query
{ signal: request.signal } — client abort kills the call
the only place the model gets to decide anything
keeps the last non-empty text as the answer
echoes the tool_use blocks back with their ids
one result per tool_use id, in call order
zod-validates the input against the tool schema
runs on the caller's RLS-scoped client — no service role
entity · op · id — the client's cache-invalidation list
tool_use_id · content · is_error — a failure is fed back, not thrown
tripId ← the tracked create_trip change event
always the last event of the run
one JSON per line — progress · change · error · result
events reach the UI while the loop is still running
throw → emit error event, then close()
events collected in memory, nothing sent until the end
emit() is picked before the loop starts
The loop has exactly three exits: 16-iteration cap, a max_tokens stop, and a reply with no tool_use.
A truncated response is never executed — its tool_use block may be incomplete.
No undo. The client applies the change events by invalidating query keys.
